decision: Rejected coarse token index and single-token shortcut; production source restored to proven baseline.
scope: Shared active desktop GPU. Synthetic images, Python transport included. No desktop changes or restart.

experiments.name: 8-byte coarse token index
experiments.result: No net noisy-image gain; solid total median 129.8 to 151.7 ms. Rejected.

experiments.name: direct single-token resolution
experiments.result: Solid total median 145.7 to 146.2 ms; noisy 891.0 to 894.6 ms. No meaningful gain. Rejected.

checks: nix build . and nix run .#graphics-test exited zero for all candidates (36 cases).

Initial coarse-index candidate also passed nix run .#sync-test, real browser pixel/input integration via nix develop, and focused CUDA memcheck/racecheck via nix develop. These do not certify later rejected variants.
